title: Optimized Well
description: Speedy & optimized taking minecraft into next level!
body:
We hear you. Thats why we made this!
Introducing "Optimized Well 1.0.0" for Fabric 1.21.
with a well performance boost on almost every laptops and pcs
with a high boost speed and optimised gui.

The Mod Pack contains **_Sodium & Sodium Extra_** for better game performance. So using Optifine will crash the game. Just install the mod pack and add it to your **mods** folder in .minecraft. The mods can be visible while downloading.

We have run tests on a 10year old Laptop on which we got around a constant 90FPS. So in newer PC/Laptops, don't worry about FPS issues.

Performance
Sodium and Other supporting mods such as lithium , Krypton, nvidium etc. will enhance the current game mechanics and improve the fluctuations on game performance

If any issues occur, feel free to ask for support in our Discord and we'll try to help out!
